newsitem.title: ROMANIA: MELESCANU'S U.S. VISIT ON FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: MELESCANU'S U.S. VISIT ON FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.

text.p: Romanian Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu starts a two-day visit to the United States on Wednesday to deliver President Ion Iliescu's message to U.S. President Bill Clinton on Romania's commitment to join NATO, ministry spokesman Gabriel Gafita told a news conference.
* Melescanu will also start visit to Canada on October 4. He will meet Canadian Prime Minister Jean Luc Chretien.
The ministry's news briefing agenda also included:

* Romania's inter-ministerial committee for European integration will meet on October 3. The main issue will be Romania's participation at the second session of Romania-U.E. Association Committee on October 10 in Brussels.

* U.S. Army General George Joulwan, supreme Allied Commander of all NATO Forces in Europe, starts visit on Wednesday to review with Romanian officials cooperation within Partnership for Peace and NATO-led Bosnia peacekeeping mission.

* Bucharest will host international conference starting October 7, organised by New York-based Institute for Est-West Studies and foreign ministry, to discuss role of sub-regional bodies in "New European security model for the 21st century."
* Turkish-Romanian joint economic commision will meet on October 7 in Bucharest.
